shortDescription: U.S. Energy Secretary Wright said the U.S. military is helping move oil, natural gas, and fertilizer through the Strait of Hormuz. According to ChainCatcher, nearly 13 million barrels of oil are transported through the strait each day.

title: U.S. Energy Secretary Wright Says Military Is Helping Protect Hormuz Strait Shipments
